parts.content:
# Dialog — markup contract (the design ↔ behavior seam)

This file is the **shared vocabulary** between the behavior layer (machine + connectors,
which *set* these attributes) and the design layer (`core/design/dialog.css`, which
*styles* them). It is a human-readable spec — **not** a code dependency. Neither layer
imports the other; they meet only here (behavior-layer-design.md §2).

## Parts (`part="…"`)

| Part      | Element role                                  | Notes |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|-------|
| `overlay` | Full-viewport backdrop behind the dialog      | Click-to-dismiss is a connector concern, not styling. |
| `content` | The dialog surface / panel                    | Carries `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`; receives `resize`/dimensions when `ctx.resizable`. |
| `title`   | The dialog heading                            | Referenced by `aria-labelledby` from `content`. |
| `close`   | The close affordance (button)                 | Wired to the `CLOSE` event by the connector. |

## State attribute (`data-state="…"`)

Behavior emits the current FSM state outward via `data-state` on `overlay` and `content`:

| `data-state` | Meaning                                                        |
|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| `open`       | Dialog is open (FSM state `open`).                             |
| `closed`     | Dialog is closed (FSM state `closed`).                         |
| `animatingOut` | Closing animation in flight; `ANIMATION_END` returns to `closed`. |

> The §1.3 contract names `data-state ∈ {open, closed}` as the canonical pair the design
> layer must handle; `animatingOut` is a transient value design MAY animate but is not
> required to (it falls back to the `closed`-like hidden treatment when unstyled).

## Config surface (drives attributes / inline style, not new parts)

- **scroll / no-scroll** — `ctx.scrollable`: connector toggles `.scrollable` on `content`;
  CSS provides scroll vs no-scroll variants (`core/design/dialog.css`).
- **resizable + dimensions** — `ctx.resizable` / `ctx.width` / `ctx.height`: connector emits
  inline `resize/overflow/width/height` on `content` only when `canResize(ctx)` is true.
- **open / close** — the `OPEN` / `CLOSE` / `ANIMATION_END` events on the machine.

## Accessibility baseline (borrowed from Radix's API shape, not its delivery)

- `content`: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby` → the `title` id.
- Focus is trapped on `open` (`trapFocus`) and released on close (`releaseFocus`) — declared
  as entry/exit action names in `machine.js`; each connector performs them for its own DOM.
